summary_md: **すけりょ ([@14kawa_sukeryo](https://x.com/14kawa_sukeryo/status/2116165688482279861))** summarizes *Just Action Models* ([arXiv 2610.37219](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37219)) from the University of Tokyo's Yamazaki lab, which predicts future feature representations instead of pixels and beats prior methods on LIBERO-Plus, separating generating the future from understanding it, akin to JEPA.

referenced_urls.title: Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models
